title: datasets: a measure or dimension published with neither synonyms nor a description gets an advisory, and the build skills write both in the user's language
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17. On the synonyms layer, verbatim: 「同意，所以hotcrm 也需要立卡改进对吧」, answering the seat's three-layer proposal (authors write synonyms; the server hints on a zero-match; the client asks back).

## Why

Synonyms are the platform's answer to a question asked in the user's own words (ADR-0149 D1), and nothing prompts an author to write them. An app can publish eleven datasets with none and every check stays green; its users then get ungoverned numbers for questions the app has a governed metric for.

Who acts: the spec lane for the advisory (`packages/lint`), the skills lane for the teaching. Who reads the result: an app author, human or AI, at publish time.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, hotcrm `ddcd6e6`, read 2026-11-17)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:291-303` teaches `synonyms` and member `description` in one TypeScript example. No rule says when a dataset is incomplete without them.
- No rule in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` reads `synonyms` (`grep -n -i synonym packages/lint/src` finds no dataset rule).
- hotcrm: 11 datasets, no dataset synonym, no member description (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2593).
- On that app's live environment 6 of 30 natural business words matched a metric, and none of the 16 Chinese ones.

## Scope

- One advisory finding (a warning, never a refusal) on a dataset measure or dimension that has no `synonyms` and no `description`, naming the member and saying what a user loses. Runtime publish gate and CLI.
- The dataset teaching in the published skills says: write the words a person types, in the language of the request, and a one-sentence business definition; one word names one member.
- File surface: `packages/lint/src/**`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` and its evals.

## Done when

- Publishing `examples/app-crm` raises no such finding, and a dataset stripped of both raises one per member.
- An eval case covers "author a dataset for a Chinese brief" and expects Chinese synonyms.

## Out of scope

- Synonyms on objects or fields: not added, by the maintainer's agreement in the same chat. Any change to matching.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Sibling: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2593. The advisory is a product rule an author sees, not a repository gate.
- Dedup, open and closed: `dataset synonyms skill teach in:title` 1 hit, #31659 (closed), which added the teaching example this card extends; `list_datasets synonyms` 1 hit, the parent.
